rulesClauses: Look at the top five cards of your deck. You may activate a Ranger action card with reserve cost 2 or less from among them without paying its costs. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. BerthaChooseAction was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the free activation (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods() skip the handler and its decline branch (BerthaPutRestOnBottom) never ran: all five looked-at cards stayed in the temp zone and the deck was five cards short (live repro on HEAD: deck 14 instead of 19). Fix: dontSkipOnPass:1 at the queue site.
